name: NASA SMAP & MSL telemetry
description: Real telemetry from the SMAP satellite and the Curiosity rover with 105 expert-labeled anomalies (Hundman et al., KDD 2018).

name: Kepler Q1-Q17 DR24 TCEs + MAST light curves
description: Threshold-crossing events flagged by the Kepler pipeline, labeled PC / AFP / NTP, with each star's long-cadence light curve from MAST.

name: NASA JPL AI4Mars (Curiosity NAVCAM)
description: Rover images with crowdsourced terrain labels and expert-labeled test sets (soil, bedrock, sand, big rock).

name: NASA OMNIWeb OMNI2 hourly solar wind + indices
description: Near-Earth solar-wind plasma and IMF measured at L1 (ACE, Wind, DSCOVR) with the Dst, Kp, AE and F10.7 indices, one record per hour since 1963.
